The project covers the living room, bedrooms, a kitchen with built-in appliances, walk-in closets, an entrance hall, bathrooms, and functional storage areas. All rooms are united by a single interior concept in which materials, color combinations, lighting, and furniture solutions have been carefully considered. Custom-made furniture was designed and manufactured for the private house, including the kitchen, built-in wardrobes, walk-in closets, shelving, and storage systems. The furniture was designed to suit the room dimensions, layout features, and overall style of the interior. This approach made it possible to use the space efficiently and ensure the visual coherence of the living environment. In preparation for implementation, technical documentation and a detailed cost estimate were prepared, covering construction and finishing work, materials, furniture, appliances, plumbing fixtures, lighting, and other items specified in the project. After the design stage was completed, a full turnkey renovation of the private house in Kyiv was carried out in accordance with the developed interior solutions and technical documentation. The implementation included construction and finishing work, installation of the custom furniture, and fitting out of the living spaces. To preview the future interior, photorealistic 3D visualizations were created, making it possible to review the layout solutions, combination of materials, furniture, lighting, and overall atmosphere of the rooms before work began. The 217 m² private house project showcases DUMSKAYA DESIGN’s end-to-end approach to creating contemporary residential interiors — from the interior design project and technical documentation to furniture manufacturing and the finished interior.
